commands.summary: Backend build passed after adding the email adapter (email.ts), the email_send/inbound_email capabilities, registration, and the email_configured diagnostic.

12 email tests passed: address/attachment validation, MIME plain+multipart assembly, retryable vs permanent error classification, inbound normalization, capability advertisement, and the send matrix (success, redacted provider rejection, transient retryable, missing credentials, invalid recipient, attachment bounds).
Server tests passed with the email adapter registered when configured and the redacted email_configured diagnostic.
Full Electron validation passed including the new email test file.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed for the work-item, docs, evidence, and CHANGELOG updates.

environment.process_note: EMAIL-001/003/008. Provider-neutral email adapter; outbound SMTP send behind the channel registry, registered only when FORGELINK_SMTP_HOST/USER/PASS/FROM are set. Deterministic tests use an injected fake transport; the default sendSmtpEmail submission client (implicit TLS or STARTTLS, AUTH LOGIN) is operator-verified live, analogous to the opt-in live-Twilio test. Credentials/addresses/bodies are never logged or surfaced; diagnostics expose only a boolean. Deferred to later EMAIL criteria: secure-storage UI (002), inbound ingest (004), configuration/contact UI (005), signed quick-actions (006), and full backup/export/retention participation (007).
